files.holds: Principal particulars, complement, registry and dates, MVZ count, life-saving appliances (no liferaft capacity), reference to EA-101
A3 landscape GA deck 5 (MVZ 3), drawn at 1:200, title block says 1:100. Rev A: stair B 850 mm. Particulars box says LOA 300.10 m.
A3 landscape GA deck 5 (MVZ 3), drawn at 1:200, title block says 1:100. Rev B: stair B widened to 1000 mm, revision cloud, revision row B.
Rev A geometry with every character drawn as single-stroke line paths: no text layer, like a plotted CAD drawing.
Rev A rasterized at 150 dpi, grey, rotated 0.4 degrees, blur and noise. One JPEG image per page.
Same scan as the image-only PDF, lossless PNG.
Sheet 'DOOR SCHEDULE DECK 5': title row 1, note row 2, header row 3, 12 door rows. Blank cells: 5108 clear width, 5112 opening depth.
Same table as the xlsx, header in row 1. No in-file marking, a comment row would break CSV parsers.
Stairs A, B, C on deck 5 with rev A values (B = 850). No in-file marking, see door-schedule.csv.
12 IfcDoor (SYN_DoorData, OverallWidth = clear + 100) and 3 IfcStairFlight (SYN_EscapeData); stair C 950, door 5110 clear 900, door 5108 no ClearWidth, door 5112 no OpeningDepth.
Simplified method MSC.1/Circ.1533: R+T 38.0, E+L 30.0, total 67.5 min, governing Case 1 (night), 7 MVZ.
